description: This Java class serves as a Spring MVC controller for managing system configuration settings within the admin section of the application. It handles HTTP GET and POST requests to display and save system configuration data, interacting with the MerchantConfigurationService and managing model attributes for rendering views.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing system configuration views and updates for the admin interface.

methods.name: displaySysyemConfgurations
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to display the current system configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: saveSystemConfigurations
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to save updated system configuration data for a merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu attributes in the model for view rendering, based on the request context.
